A bill for an act relating to local government; authorizing amortization of certain property uses; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.357, subdivision 1c.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.357, subdivision 1c, is amended to read:

Subd. 1c.
Amortization prohibited.
[+(a) +]Except as otherwise provided in this subdivision, a municipality must not enact, amend, or enforce an ordinance providing for the elimination or termination of a use by amortization which use was lawful at the time of its inception.
[+(b)+] This subdivision does not apply to[+: +]
[+(1)+] adults-only bookstores, adults-only theaters, or similar adults-only businesses, as defined by ordinance[-.-][+; or +]

[+(2) in a city of the first class, a nonconforming industrial use in an environmental justice area as defined by section 116.065, subdivision 1. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to local government; authorizing amortization of certain property uses; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.357, subdivision 1c.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.357, subdivision 1c, is amended to read:

Subd. 1c.
Amortization prohibited.
(a) Except as otherwise provided in this subdivision, a municipality must not enact, amend, or enforce an ordinance providing for the elimination or termination of a use by amortization which use was lawful at the time of its inception.
(b) This subdivision does not apply to:
(1) adults-only bookstores, adults-only theaters, or similar adults-only businesses, as defined by ordinance; or

(2) in a city of the first class, a nonconforming industrial use in an environmental justice area as defined by section 116.065, subdivision 1.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (2) in a city of the first class, a nonconforming industrial use in an environmental justice area as defined by section 116.065, subdivision 1.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
